q: In the name of Allaah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.
v.s: In the name of God, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
v.c: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

q: All praise belongs to Allaah, the Rabb
v.s: [All] praise is [due] to God, Lord of the worlds -
v.c: All praise is for Allah—Lord of all worlds,

q: Who is the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful...
v.s: The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,

q: (the Day of Qiyaamah, when resurrection, accountability, rewards and punishment will take place).
v.s: Sovereign of the Day of Recompense.
v.c: Master of the Day of Judgment.

q: You Alone do we worship, and You Alone do we ask for help.
v.s: It is You we worship and You we ask for help.
v.c: You ˹alone˺ we worship and You ˹alone˺ we ask for help.

q: Guide us to the straight path
v.s: Guide us to the straight path -
v.c: Guide us along the Straight Path,

q: the path of those whom You have favored
...and not the path of those with whom You are angry
nor the path of those who have gone astray
v.s: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray.
v.c: the Path of those You have blessed—not those You are displeased with, or those who are astray.
